intro: Harpy Lieutenant Rings are crude ornaments worn by the Witchwing Slayers in the Dry Hills of the northern Barrens. Carried as emblems of command among the flock, they serve as proof of death for Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

p: Within the matriarchal hierarchy of the Witchwing harpies, rank is ruthlessly maintained. While the rank-and-file raiders harrying the Barrens fight with little coordination, the Witchwing Slayers serve as field lieutenants directing assaults against Horde travelers. To distinguish themselves and assert authority over their underlings, these veteran slayers carry distinctive rings. For Darsok Swiftdagger and the defenders stationed at the Crossroads, severing these rings from fallen harpies is the only sure way to confirm that the flock's middle leadership has been broken.
